\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Cardinality of the Boolean cube]
\lean{FABL.card_f₂Cube}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.F₂Cube, FABL.𝔽₂}
\difficulty{1}
For every natural number $n$, the set of vectors of length $n$ over the two-element
field has cardinality $2^n$.
\end{theorem}
